description: Runtime coverage plan of the English patch (tools/patch/coverage_campaign.py). Every item reaches one text the player can see, from power-on or from the state of the item it names in `from`; pokes are the save-block / step-machine addresses of docs/reference/KONAMI-DEBUG-FACILITIES.md sections 6-7.

expected_japanese.why: name-entry kana / symbol / kanji key grids: read by column position and compared with what the player types, kept Japanese on purpose (PS1-PATCH-STATUS.md section 4, item 4)
name-entry symbol / kanji key rows (built on the stack from the font's JIS order): the same key grids
the name fields themselves after the campaign typed kana / kanji keys (a Japanese name is the player's choice)
